newsitem.title: USA: Horizon/CMS reports improved results despite charge.
newsitem.headline: Horizon/CMS reports improved results despite charge.

text.p: Horizon/CMS Healthcare Corp. reported $8 million in profits in the latest quarter Friday after a $28.9 million loss in the previous year's quarter.

Earnings per share in the hospital and rehabilitation clinic company's first fiscal quarter ended Aug. 31 were 15 cents, compared with a loss of 56 cents a share in the year-ago quarter, the Albuquerque, N.M.-based company said.
Horizon/CMS operates 95 rehabilitation hospitals, speciality hospitals and other facilities, 194 outpatient rehabiliation clinics, and more than 260 nursing homes.

Excluding special charges, Horizon/CMS earned $12.4 million, or 24 cents a share, vs. $18.6 million, or 36 cents per share a year ago. In the latest first quarter, the company recorded a pretax charge of $7.2 million related to the restructuring of a corporate office in Pennsylvania.
Sales rose 3 percent to $443.6 million from $431.4 million.

In another development Friday, Diagnostic Health Services Inc. in Dallas announced it agreed to buy Horizon/CMS's Advanced Clinical Technology Inc. unit for $13 million in cash and $4.5 million in preferred stock. The unit provides ultrasound diagnostics and related services to hospitals, doctors' offices and other health care facilities.
The deal is expected to be completed in November.
Horizon/CMS stock was unchanged at $11.875 on the New York Stock Exchange.
